title: Refuse PDF preparation for unresolved violations
description: Block PDF preparation by default whenever current non-overridden scene violations exist and present actionable ways to locate and correct each offending element.
acceptanceCriteria: Any current SceneViolation makes PDF preparation unavailable by default
Refusal returns the exact ordered violation identities used by preview diagnostics
Each refusal offers an actionable path to the affected page, assignment, element, and relevant safety control
No PDF bytes, object URL, success state, output hash, or print preparation is created on refusal
Resolving every violation enables preparation without requiring an override
Unknown radius alone follows TASK-56 and is not misclassified as proof or as a known violation

steps.details: Insert current SafeRegionResult and SceneViolation validation before PDF renderer invocation and return a typed refusal when one or more violations remain.
Reuse TASK-31 failure handling to ensure refused attempts create no renderer input, bytes, URL, hash, success event, or preparation record.
Render the stable violation list with controls that focus the offending assignment/element or associated tolerance/inset input without relying on color.
Attempt generation with one and multiple violations, assert atomic refusal, correct them by keyboard, and assert ordinary generation becomes available.

technicalNotes: Keep this task under ten minutes by extending the existing structured PDF refusal seam.
Default refusal enforces the user's requested software geometry; it is not a claim that passing output is physically safe.
